full_prompt_en: A square, painterly bust image shows a dark-haired woman in a black sleeveless garment against a sharply divided pale and black background. The left side is warm off-white with light scratches, stains, and exposed underpainting, while the right half falls into near-black and merges with her hair and clothing. She is placed slightly left of center, shoulders angled toward the viewer and head tilted a little to the right. Dark hair is swept loosely back, with a few fine strands crossing the side of her face and neck. The visible face has warm cream and olive shadows, heavy dark eyes, a straight nose, and parted lips. Her gaze is direct but subdued, and the face is the most carefully modeled area of the painting. A narrow black strap follows the outer edge of each shoulder; the neckline sits low across the upper chest and then loses definition in the lower darkness. The bare shoulders and collarbones receive broad strokes of gold, tan, and pale cream, interrupted by darker, scratch-like marks. Along the right side, both the garment and the backdrop dissolve into a large black block, making the pale face and shoulders appear to emerge from shadow. The lower edge crops the torso before any hands are visible. Brushwork is rougher around the figure and background than in the central facial planes, with dragged edges and small gaps of raw pale ground. Light comes from the upper left, striking forehead, cheek, and the near shoulder while the right side falls quickly into black. The overall composition uses a compact, luminous head-and-shoulder triangle against a stark two-tone ground, creating an intimate and unfinished-looking tension.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、绘画感强的半身图像描绘一位黑发女子，穿黑色无袖衣，身后背景明显分为浅色与黑色。左侧为暖灰白，带轻划痕、污斑和露出的底层颜料；右半边落入近黑色，与她的头发和衣服融合。她位于中央稍偏左，肩膀朝向观者，头略向右倾。深发松松向后收起，少量细发丝横过脸侧与脖颈。可见面部有暖奶油色与橄榄色阴影，深眼、直鼻和微张嘴唇清楚。目光直接却低沉，脸是整幅最仔细塑形的区域。细黑肩带沿双肩外缘延伸；领口低横过上胸，随后在下方黑暗中失去清楚边界。裸露的肩膀和锁骨以金色、棕褐和浅奶油色宽笔触呈现，其间被较深刮痕状笔迹打断。右侧衣服与背景溶成大黑块，使浅色面庞与肩膀像从阴影中浮出。下缘在双手出现前截断身体。人物周边和背景笔触比中央脸部更粗，有拖曳边缘与裸露浅底的小空隙。光从左上照来，击中额头、面颊和近侧肩膀，右侧迅速落入黑色。整体构图以紧凑发亮的头肩三角形对照鲜明双色背景，产生亲密而近乎未完成的张力。
style_prompt_en: The image has a rough yet selectively refined painted finish, with dragged dark masses surrounding smoother warm tonal passages. Near black and distressed off-white form a stark split field; small olive, tan, and golden notes add warmth inside the pale focal area. Edges are deliberately incomplete, dissolving into deep shadow on one side and breaking into scratches and exposed ground on the other. Directional upper-side light isolates a compact central volume, then falls away quickly with little reflected detail. Brushmarks remain visible at transitions, giving the surface a raw, worked quality. The overall effect is intimate and high contrast, balancing softness in the lit core against abrasion around its boundaries.
style_prompt_zh: 图像有粗涩却有选择地精细处理的绘画完成面，拖曳的深色体块围住较平滑的暖色调性区域。近黑与斑驳灰白形成鲜明分割色域；少量橄榄、棕褐和金色音符在浅色焦点内添暖。边缘有意不完整，一侧融入深影，另一侧碎为划痕和裸露底面。上侧定向光孤立紧凑中央体积，随后迅速衰减，反光细节很少。笔迹在过渡处可见，让表面生涩而有加工感。整体效果亲密且高反差，以受光核心的柔和对照边界周围的磨蚀。
theme_en: A dark-haired woman in a black sleeveless garment against a divided pale-and-black background
theme_zh: 黑发女子穿黑色无袖衣，背后是浅色与黑色相分的背景
name: Mark Demsteader
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
